title: Your Praise Is So Beautiful. One
summary: The shabad does not leave anxiety at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across
lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across; i can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens
source.lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.

evidence.coreClaim: Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across; i can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens
evidence.turn: Hardship is not automatically holy, but it can become the place where reality is finally faced.
evidence.practicalImplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
